units: w h border = design px (1080-wide canvas); scale = raster px per design px (store size = w*scale); pivot = 0..1 from bottom-left (Unity Sprite.Create); border order L T R B; fps = timeline rate; timeline[i] = unique drawing index shown at frame i; events keyed by timeline frame index

naming.existing: every v4 atlas name stays; status replace3d = same name, same design size, same pivot and border, new 3D pixels; keep2d = untouched SVG raster
naming.clipFrames: <frameName with {NN}> = two-digit unique drawing index, e.g. chr_king_idle_00
naming.new: new names never reuse a v4 name; chr_dede_* stay as deprecated aliases rendered as Usta Kral

colorManagement.file: PNG RGBA 8 bit, straight (unassociated) alpha, sRGB
colorManagement.why: AgX (all looks) and Filmic measurably desaturate the O/Y/G block hues; Standard keeps the D-083 palette (see ART_3D 6.3)
colorManagement.engine: CYCLES, device CPU, use_denoising False (Ubuntu blender 4.0.2 has no OpenImageDenoise; EEVEE needs libEGL and aborts headless)
colorManagement.downsample: Pillow Image.LANCZOS to the store size
colorManagement.alphaBleed: after downsampling copy the nearest opaque RGB into fully transparent pixels (4 px) so bilinear filtering has no dark fringe
